dependencySomeCoreBackendFilesAreMissing: Yenn fichier backend core yi amul wala dañu yàqu — loolu dafay tekki ni yebbite bi dafa dakkal wala archive bi dañu ko jële ci wàll. efaase backend bi te yebbiwaat ko ci Novera jekkal yi.
dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Sampal NCCL ci NVIDIA dalub taggatkat bi. NCCL dees na ko jefandikoo ngir ay GPU yu bare di jokkoo mboolo.
dependencyInstallNcclViaTheNvidiaPackage: Sampaale NCCL jaaraleko ci NVIDIA dencukaay bi. Ci Debian/Ubuntu : sudo apt install libnccl2 libnccl-dev. Xoolal NVIDIA NCCL tegtali samp ngir sa séddale.
dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Sampaale cuDNN ci NVIDIA dalub defarkat bi te nga teg DLL yi ci wetu jëfekaay bi wala ci biir System32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Sampale cuDNN jaaraleko ci NVIDIA mbaa nga yebbi tarball bi te nga kopie libs yi ci /usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Sampaale Vulkan ci LunarG. Sa GPU dawalkat bi mën naa ko boole — njëkkal yeesal sa GPU dawalkat bi.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Sampaale Vulkan yobbukat bi: ci Ubuntu/Debian : sudo apt install libvulkan1. Ci kaw Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. On RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkitFromNvidi: Sampaale CUDA ci NVIDIA. Sooy samp, tannal cër "CUDA".
Sampaale CUDA ci NVIDIA. Ci Debian/Ubuntu : sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Ci RHEL/Fedora: jëfandikoo NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit11FromNvi: Sampaale CUDA Jumtukaay 11 ci NVIDIA. Sooy samp, tannal cër "CUDA".
Samp CUDA Toolkit 11 bu NVIDIA. Ci Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-11. Ci RHEL/Fedora: jëfandikoo repo NVIDIA.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit12FromNvi: Sampaale CUDA Jumtukaay 12 ci NVIDIA. Sooy samp, tannal cër "CUDA".
Sampaale CUDA Jumtukaay 12 ci NVIDIA. Ci Debian/Ubuntu : sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Ci RHEL/Fedora: jëfandikoo NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit13FromNvi: Jëf CUDA Toolkit 13 ci NVIDIA. Ci installation, xool "CUDA" yi.
Sampaale CUDA Jumtukaay 13 ci NVIDIA. Ci Debian/Ubuntu : sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-13. Ci RHEL/Fedora: jëfandikoo NVIDIA repo.
